reviews.text: We had an amazing experience working with Justin Bright on our pool. From start to finish, he was honest, genuine, and incredibly professional. His team stayed on schedule, communicated clearly, and the quality of the work was outstanding. We were just talking recently about how impressed we were with his skills. Not just in building a beautiful pool, but in how he runs his business with integrity and heart. If you’re looking for someone you can truly trust to bring your vision to life, Justin is the one.
reviews.author: Grace Robles

reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience with Bright Pools! From start to finish, their team was efficient, detail-oriented, and incredibly responsive. Every step of the project was handled with professionalism, and they made sure to keep me informed throughout the process. I couldn’t be happier with the final result. If you’re considering building a pool, I highly recommend Bright Pools.
reviews.author: Connor Paroski

reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about this company. The entire process with Bright was seamless!! We had a vision for what we wanted in a pool, and Justin and his team brought it to life. We appreciated the constant communication throughout the process, and it is very clear that Justin takes GREAT pride in the quality of his work. We even followed a few of his recommendations (including springing for the UV/ozone 👌) and he didn’t steer us wrong! Two years in, and we’ve recommended them to a number of neighbors and family. We’re still extremely pleased and we know that we can reach back out if we ever need anything or have questions! Thank you, Bright!!
reviews.author: Allison Barger

reviews.text:
We are absolutely thrilled with our experience working with Bright Pools! From start to finish, their team was professional, responsive, and completely committed to bringing our vision to life. Every step of the process — from the initial design consultation to the final touches — was handled with care, precision, and clear communication.

Their craftsmanship is top-notch, and the attention to detail shows in every corner of our beautiful new pool. They listened to what we wanted, offered expert suggestions, and went above and beyond to make sure everything turned out even better than we imagined. We truly appreciated how smoothly the project ran and how respectful and friendly every team member was along the way.

Thanks to Bright Pools, we now have our own backyard oasis, and we couldn’t be happier! If you’re looking for a pool company that is honest, skilled, and truly cares about their clients — look no further. Bright Pools is the best in the business!
reviews.author: Mandy Hillner

reviews.text: Bright Pools installed the perfect pool for me. The size and shape fit my yard and style wonderfully. It brings me joy whether I am swimming or sitting outside, enjoying the beauty of the dark, sparkling ripples. Although the process was intimidating, Justin was informative when explaining the various phases. Ivan, the project director, was responsive and accommodating. Their expertise, professionalism, and courtesy truly reflected the high quality of work being done.
reviews.author: Ornell

reviews.text:
Thank you  Bright pools!!!! My family is enjoying our pool so much!!
From Justin coming to meet us, to Kate and Shane meeting us in the office on short notice. They always answered our questions... Will  was our  project manager, thank you  for making this process as easy as it was!!! The bright crews who came and completed the pool , took care of business!!
Thank you Bright Pool!!!!
reviews.author: Jose

reviews.text: For my retirement home I wanted a pool but wasn't sure my new yard was large enough.  From start to finish we were able to design more than I thought possible or imagined.  The design and installation were without complication.  Efficient, family friendly service all the way.  A couple house keeping issues at the end that were IMMEDIATELY remedied.  I cannot recommend them highly enough.  I am so very pleased!
reviews.author: Sandie Meurer

reviews.text:
Incompetent

After almost two years of major issues with our project (not to speak of the normal minor thing with any project) and countless opportunities for Justin Bright to actually fix those issues not just show up and make hollow promises and be left with either the issues unattended for 3+ months or the “fix” done by cutting every corner possible it’s time for a public review.

Don’t be fooled by the nice country guy persona because our experience has been nothing but incompetent design, cheap work, and blaming subcontractors.

We have had multiple leaks in our pool (all of which had to be repaired by another company before Justin even got someone out to check on it 3 months later), our neighbors yard and foundation has been flooded because Bright ran our pool drain right to our fence line even though it’s obvious their yard is lower than ours and then the pop up buried under rocks, our covered pergola drained straight down onto our outdoor kitchen do to poor design by Bright and then given 6 months to actually fix it we made Justin replace our appliances and had to pay another company to come out and actually fix the roofline. We had to have all the electrical redone because either the lights wouldn’t work or the spa light was connected to the water feature meaning the light was on all day and you couldn’t control it. The autofill broke 2 months in and we just ran water constantly flooding our neighbors yard because of where they ran the drain, then when Justin sent out someone to fix the drain after our neighbor called him personally to complain about his lazy incompetent work he sent out a guy who ran the drain uphill(!!!) into the city alley and the didn’t glue the pipes together and it came apart in the first big rain. Then he came to “fix” that and for some reason ran it out into the tire tracks of the alley and low and behold not a week later someone ran over it! Oh and we’ve had to replace the spa heater and pool cleaning robot too all within the first year.

Do yourself a favor, just YouTube “How to build a pool” and do it yourself: I’m pretty sure that’s all Justin Bright is doing.
reviews.author: Trevor Bodine
